coverageLimits: The16-frame pixel matrix includes explicitly forced public presentation-cue stimuli; these do not prove gameplay locomotion or damage. Real events are recorded separately.
Beacon flags and clock positions immediately before7/14/21seconds are declared fixtures; native update creates each reinforcement pair. No22second defense journey or beacon interaction is claimed.
Reduced-motion behavior belongs to the separate targeted code suite; no reduced-motion Canvas matrix is claimed here.
Cyan/magenta source fringe, dense70px details and faint alpha0.3 corpses remain. No source pixel cleanup or resizing per pose was performed.

Names, bars and the guard warning ellipse retain native geometry. Only the last QueenMother adaptation HUD line is excluded from Q HUD pixel equality. Other ecosystems and the adult Q isolated render have strict comparators.
Synthetic viewport-boundary probes are separate from naturally settled world camera scenes.
No browser, audio, networked deployment or complete campaign playthrough is claimed.
No canonical caste or scale is assigned to the native guard role; Choirs and complete-royal-cast remain open.
Native loot and particles partly occlude the corpse in world captures; isolated forced death views show its shape. Visible world draw attribution and disappearance are verified separately.
The native camera shifts by less than1pixel during the death sequence while guard x/y/w/h remain unchanged.
Zero measured pivot error is agreement with the approved approximate anatomical landmarks, not a claim of perfect anatomical certainty.

The seven frozen owner/runtime files are enforced before every capture;22 source/host/test hashes and4 source PNG hashes are recorded before/after. This is not a hash of every transitive module in the repository.
Attempt01 stopped with system exit137 before the forced matrix; its10PNG and receipt are preserved and excluded from all successful counts. The cause was not established.

visualReview.artAgentReview: completed; no new concrete visual defect
visualReview.rootReview: accepted through team message after actual inspection of impact, warning, pursuit, death at0/0.3/1.25, overview and both pose grids
visualReview.scope: Placement, mirrored whole creatures, native labels/bars and guard ellipse accepted. Reuse is an adapted role appearance, with no canonical caste assignment.
existingLimits: Cyan/magenta atlas fringe remains visible around parts of the silhouette.
Fine anatomy is dense at70pixel rest height; death alpha0.3 is deliberately faint.
Native loot and particles partly occlude the corpse in world death captures. These captures prove admission and expiry, not full corpse legibility.
Manual anatomical pivots have estimated source uncertainty ±5–8pixels; the reported zero pivot error verifies transform conformance to those approved landmarks, not exact anatomical truth.
The native camera continues settling by less than1world pixel during the death sequence; target physical coordinates stay fixed.

reviewGrids.creation: Unscaled assembly of existing native PNG captures; no new native render or source-pixel edit
Unscaled assembly of existing native PNG captures; no new native render or source-pixel edit

historicalAttempts.cause: Not established; no functional verdict from incomplete attempt

nativeFinalFreeze.protection: Final receipt, overview, raw captures, source atlas and preexisting artifacts are frozen; no repository source was modified by art QA.

calibrationData.anatomicalDefinition: Horizontal projection of manually read pelvis/hip junction onto the independently sampled anatomical support boundary. Hip Y is recorded but never locked: crouch, recoil and collapse retain their vertical displacement. No alpha-box center used as horizontal pivot.

pairedLandmarkReview.note: Manual reading, not anatomy ground truth; uncertainty5–8sourcepx is about2.17–3.48worldpx at proposed scale.

limits: Prototype placement only; no native controller, game loading, collision, damage, save, resume or camera journey executed.
Exactly one untouched existing atlas; no generated or edited source pixels.
The16 source frames do not establish a canonical caste or physique for the mission guards.
Alive/dead and windup values in the prototype are explicit display fixtures, not state-selection proof.
Support regions are manually selected parts of feet/tail/body; alpha sampling refines their lower boundary only.
Frame12 has raised feet; the tail loop is lowest, not an invented standing pose.
The second foot in several living cells sits slightly above the support plane in the painted view; it is not independently snapped down.
Whole source cells are sampled uniformly; no per-pose scale, alpha crop or Y-pelvis lock.

observations: Silhouettes, mirror pairs and full source cells are readable at the proposed reference height.
Per-pose pelvis projections avoid the horizontal offset visible with one pivot, notably contact frame9 and final corpse15.
Native name and health bar remain separate, guard telegraph is an ellipse, corpse uses native alpha0.3.
limits: Static placement prototype, not native combat or temporal-motion verification.
Cyan/magenta contour remains in the reused source.
Dark corpse follows native alpha0.3; low label contrast on diagnostic light background is preserved.
Manual pelvis readings have declared uncertainty; zero pelvis drift is a placement construction, not a measured movement improvement.
70px role stature is an explicit project adaptation; no canonical caste or 1:1 certification.

groupedRun.accounting: 56 positive cases include the 17 dedicated cases; the first run is not added again.

mutationRun.accounting: Three failing negative controls, not three extra positive tests.

harnessHistory.result: three loader needle-count errors before test assertions; no mutant detection claimed
global filename replacement accidentally changed v188 to v288; ENOENT before any test; corrected by exact filename replacements
loader is idempotent by transforming resolved frozen file bytes in memory; duplicate hook executions carry the same original and loaded SHA; all intended assertions fail

declaredFixtures: DOM, RAF and Image doubles; PNG dimensions and hashes are read from real bytes; Canvas command recorder, not raster.
Native authored Queen Mother mission with complete production GameEngine; insertion grace expires through 4.05 simulated seconds.
Negative contact controls replace damagePlayer return with 0/undefined/NaN/-1; positive contact uses the real method and a forwarding spy.
Display fixtures set clocks/windup/orientation/health for deterministic body/UI checks; a separate native sequence owns movement, contact, death, waves and resume.
Wave defence uses a high-health marine to keep real enemy attacks active while the native 22-second clock runs.
A synthetic external relocation only exercises the presentation observer rejection; it is not counted as native locomotion.

observations: All16 complete cells and both mirrors are visible in the two native pose review grids. Labels stay unmirrored and bars remain separate from the drawn bodies.
Native windup retains the guard ellipse; accepted contact shows the extended arm after windup, with no adult seven-point warning added.

Local browser, full release and publication results are not inferred from this receipt.
